entities.name: José María Vallés y Ribot
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José María Vallés y Ribot, in Catalan Josep Maria Vallès i Ribot, was a Spanish republican politician who served as legislator in the Congress of Deputies a number of times during the Restoration period between 1891 and 1910, and previously during the First Spanish Republic between 1873 and 1874.
